title: bzip2 signature
summary: A bzip2 file begins with the 3-byte signature 'BZh' (0x42 0x5A 0x68) followed by the block size digit ('1'-'9', 0x31-0x39).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: bzip2 uses the Burrows-Wheeler transform (BWT) + move-to-front + Huffman coding.
bzip2 is slower than gzip but compresses better.
